summary: Free Radical Design's psychic stealth-action game, later relisted on Steam by THQ Nordic.

entries.title: Second Sight

emulation.notes: Use the Windows release natively; Dolphin/PCSX2/xemu are only for original-console comparison.

primary.why: Second Sight released for GameCube, PlayStation 2, and Xbox in 2004, Windows in 2005, and was relisted on Steam in 2021. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most accessible modern route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows/Steam release natively; use original consoles only for preservation comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The modern route is a PC re-release, not a full remaster.
